task.ques: Locate an introductory course related to artificial intelligence on Coursera, ensuring it's suitable for beginners and contains at least one module discussing Ethical Considerations.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: IBM’s Introduction to Artificial Intelligence (AI) on Coursera meets the requirements. It is labeled “Beginner level” and states “No experience required.” Module 4 is “Issues, Concerns, and Ethical Considerations” (3 hours), covering fairness, transparency, accountability, and responsible AI.
Source: https://www.coursera.org/learn/introduction-to-ai
Screenshot evidence: final.png shows the course title, no-experience requirement, and ethics module together.
